review:
25 Magic Plums is a fruit-themed Hold the Jackpot game from Wazdan, played on 25 reels. The bonus is triggered from the central row of reels and is where the money is: Cash Infinity symbols that land stay on the reels until that bonus ends, adding to the final collection, and the round is capped by a 1,000x Grand Jackpot.

Two features keep the base game busy. A Cash Out symbol can land on any reel and stays active for 15 spins; when its countdown ends it pays a random prize plus the values of other symbols in its row. Chance Level lets you raise the bet to reach the bonus more often. Wazdan publishes a 96.15% RTP and medium-high volatility. It suits players who like hold-and-win jackpot games rather than line wins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
